@Test
public void testGenerateConfig() {
    String targetConfig = "<?xml version="1.0"?>
" + "<allocations>
" + "    <pool name="hoodiedeltasync">
" + "        <schedulingMode>FAIR</schedulingMode>
" + "        <weight>1</weight>
" + "        <minShare>2</minShare>
" + "    </pool>
" + "    <pool name="hoodiecompact">
" + "        <schedulingMode>FAIR</schedulingMode>
" + "        <weight>3</weight>
" + "        <minShare>4</minShare>
" + "    </pool>
" + "    <pool name="hoodiecluster">
" + "        <schedulingMode>FAIR</schedulingMode>
" + "        <weight>5</weight>
" + "        <minShare>6</minShare>
" + "    </pool>
" + "</allocations>";
    String generatedConfig = SchedulerConfGenerator.generateConfig(1, 3, 2, 4, 5, 6);
    assertEquals(targetConfig, generatedConfig);
}
